title: Test that an agy shell's claim resolves to the agy conversation id
action: Independently verify ase-1 (commit 3e60ba5e4). (1) In the session_identity test module, delete the vacuous test ambient_agy_session_id_is_isolated_or_preserved and add tests that drive resolve_env_session_id_from with a lookup closure: only ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID set returns it; a blank ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID falls through to CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID. Confirm the agy tests go red with ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID removed from SESSION_ENV_VARS, then restore it. (2) In every integration test file listed in files, wherever a command removes CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID from the child env, also remove ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID, so the suite passes when run from an agy shell. Prove it: run session_release with ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID=x exported and see it green (and red before the change). No code comments.
verify: ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID=x cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee session_identity && ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID=x cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test session_release --test config_verbs --test work_verbs --test route_lane_targeting --test knowledge_first_nudge --test workflow_verbs --test pi_plugin_contracts --test hook_contracts --test handoff_self_drive --test knowledge_in_the_flow_e2e
